articles.summary: Magyar Bancorp (NASDAQ: MGYR) (the "Company"), parent company of Magyar Bank, reported today the results of its operations for the three months and fiscal year ended September 30, 2026. The Company reported a 31% increase in net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026 to $3.3 million compared with net income of $2.5 million for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The Company also reported a 29% increase in net income for the year ended September 30, 2026 to $12.6 million compared with $9.8 million for the year ended September 30, 2025. The Company's basic and diluted earnings per share were $0.53 and $0.52, respectively, for the three months ended September 30, 2026 compared with $0.41 and $0.40 for the three months ended September 30, 2025. The Company's basic and diluted earnings per share were $2.02 and $1.99, respectively, for the year ended September 30, 2026 compared with $1.57 and $1.56 for the year ended September 30, 2025.
